snippet.title: Crawling Angels Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3958640/Crawling_Angels/
Join us on Discord:  https://discord.gg/bncgpveTmA

Smash and thrash the mysterious Forever Chicken a living ragdoll central to a frightful midnight carnival. Your Uncle Tontine assures "you can leave as soon as you desire" but despite their efforts no child has ever gone home... Will you be the first?
